title: The Home page, round 4 — telling the open tab apart

steps.path: Pages → Home → Climate, the pills at the top
steps.headline: Only the open tab is filled now; status colour stays in each pill's round icon, so the two can no longer be confused.
steps.changed: Your note: selected was hard to tell from the status colours. Pills no longer tint when something is on; the coloured icon says that. The open tab is filled in the text colour, in bold.
steps.notice: Shown on the Climate page, so Climate is the filled one; on the main page it is Home.
steps.risk: The pills are quieter overall: a lit pill now only shows it in its small icon.
